questions.example: Customs needs the commercial invoice before they can release the goods.
questions.exampleZh: 海關需要商業發票才能放行貨物。

questions.example: Please sign the delivery note when the boxes arrive.
questions.exampleZh: 箱子送到時請在送貨單上簽名。

questions.example: The supplier will send the certificate of origin with the shipping documents.
questions.exampleZh: 供應商會隨出貨文件一起寄上原產地證明。

questions.example: The cut-off date for this vessel is Friday, so we must finish packing by Thursday.
questions.exampleZh: 這班船的結關日是星期五，所以我們星期四前必須包裝完成。

questions.example: We paid the deposit by wire transfer yesterday.
questions.exampleZh: 我們昨天用電匯付了訂金。

questions.example: Our payment terms are net 30, so the invoice is due at the end of next month.
questions.exampleZh: 我們的付款條件是月結30天，所以這張發票下個月底到期。

questions.example: This is a rush order, so please ship it by air.
questions.exampleZh: 這是急單，所以請用空運寄送。

questions.prompt: 情境：你想請廠商提供這個產品的規格表，最自然的說法是？
options: Could you provide the spec sheet for this product?
Can you providing me spec sheet please?
questions.example: Could you provide the spec sheet for this product?
questions.exampleZh: 可以請您提供這個產品的規格表嗎？

questions.prompt: 情境：你寄出了訂購單，想請廠商回覆確認有收到，最自然的說法是？
options: Please confirm receipt of this purchase order.
Did you got my order yes?
questions.example: Please confirm receipt of this purchase order.
questions.exampleZh: 請確認是否已收到這張訂購單。

questions.prompt: 情境：你要禮貌地通知廠商，這次我們決定不下單了，最自然的說法是？
options: We regret to inform you that we will not place the order this time.
We are regret informing you no order.
Order is cancel because we don't want.
questions.example: We regret to inform you that we will not place the order this time.
questions.exampleZh: 很遺憾通知您，我們這次將不會下單。
